Alarming news that wildlife conservationists Sepideh Kashani and Houman Jowkar have been detained in Tehran, along with Sepideh’s sister Sima Kashani. Those studying our natural world should be celebrated, not persecuted.


IranWire (@IranWireEnglish)

WCS urged Iran to release environmentalists Houman Jowkar and Sepideh Kashani, re-arrested July 1, and provide legal and medical access. Sima Kashani, Sepideh's sister who has MS, was also detained. Reasons for the arrests remain unknown.
More: ir

posts.text:
“Beyond dystopian.”

Novelist Dave Eggers is sounding the alarm about AI, which he argues is harming children’s education: 

“You have a ten-year-old who is unprecedented in the history of the world. There's never been anyone like that person… To think about that one-of-a-kind-in-the-history-of-humanity person shopping their vision out to a machine, how tragic that is. That's beyond dystopian. It cannot be allowed. Not even one ounce of AI can be allowed in the humanities and youth education.”

As America turns 250, “it’s really important that we have a commitment to telling the complete story of America,” @smithsonian head Lonnie Bunch tells me. “Our job is to say, how do we tell an accurate history… that challenges America to live up to its ideals?”
